notes.title: I forget to change the price for the Early Access. Contact me for Compensation.
notes.content:
I forget to change the price for the Early Access.
In this period I get the feedback of the play that hard level is not enough. So I decide to greatly reduced the price of the game.  And I will change the price in February.20th.
Players who bought the game in old price can send Email  to me, I will give you 3 keys for compensation.
My email:  wangdunmi@163.com

notes.title: Super Dango Demo is now available
notes.content:
The Super Dango Demo shows many toturial levels and interesting levels. it also contains some hard levels in Custom Level, which can be challenged by interested players.
This version also provides a level editor to create your own level. If you want to share your wonderful levels now, you can email to me: wangdunmi@163.com

The official version will have more properties, more objects, support custom objects, custom chapters, and support the Steam [b]Workshop[/b], so that your level can be more easily shared with others.
